user_problem: For a text classifier I can vary the preprocessing order, the retrieval chunk size, and whether to use a reranker. Which outer structures clear my quality bar, and what do they cost?
bundle_offer: Bundle treats the discrete OUTER structure as the freedom (preprocessing order is a permutation; chunk and reranker are exactly-one choices), evaluates each with a LOCAL deterministic surrogate, applies a quality-gate oracle, and Pareto-ranks accuracy vs latency vs cost.
oracle: FW_VAR=4 below the 0.75 quality gate (DOMAIN_FAIL); FW_VAR=0 passes

best_candidates.reason_non_dominated: Pareto trade-off: not dominated by any of the 5 front points (better than each on ≥1 objective)
Pareto trade-off: not dominated by any of the 5 front points (better than each on ≥1 objective)
champion: strictly best minimize latency_ms (latency_ms=18.00) on the 5-point Pareto front

pareto_front_note: the formal front is over ALL executed candidates; DOMAIN_FAIL members are findings, not deployable — pick the best PASS candidate to deploy
domain_fail_examples: app=rerank_eval prep=lowercase>stem>strip_punct chunk=128 rerank=off accuracy=0.7400 latency_ms=18.00 cost_usd=0.01440 FW_VAR=4
pass_example: app=rerank_eval prep=lowercase>stem>strip_punct chunk=128 rerank=on accuracy=0.7900 latency_ms=28.80 cost_usd=0.02304 FW_VAR=0
teaching_summary: User problem (ML/LLM outer-structure evaluation). Ran 36 candidates: 34x PASS (>= quality gate), 2x below quality gate (accuracy < 0.75). Formal Pareto front of 5. Verbs: preprocessing order -> FW_Permut; retrieval chunk size -> FW_Combi(1); reranker on/off -> FW_Combi(1).
